personas.name: Professor Tanaka
personas.persona: I am Professor Tanaka, 47, a physicist at Penn. I am precise and warm with students, and happiest explaining the universe with a marker in hand.

schedule.activity: setting up for the 10:00 guest lecture on gravitational waves
holding a problem session for her physics class

personas.name: Maya Chen
personas.persona: I am Maya Chen, 19, a sophomore at Penn studying biology. I am curious, diligent, and a little caffeine-dependent. I spend most of my day studying in Van Pelt Library between classes.

schedule.activity: checking out a reserved organic chemistry textbook
studying for an organic chemistry exam
grabbing a coffee at the student union
heading to a seminar
pulling a few references off the shelves
reviewing her notes before tomorrow

personas.name: Priya Nair
personas.persona: I am Priya Nair, 20, a junior studying computer science at Penn. I am sharp, social, and always somewhere between a problem set and a coffee. Maya and I have been study buddies since freshman bio.

schedule.activity: working through a problem set with Maya
grabbing lunch between classes
pulling a dataset for a course project
heading to a lecture

personas.name: Theo Lindqvist
personas.persona: I am Theo Lindqvist, 21, a philosophy junior at Penn. I do my best thinking after dark, my worst before noon, and I will argue about footnotes with anyone who sits still long enough. My housemate Imani says I keep philosopher's hours; she is correct.

schedule.activity: surfacing for brunch long after sunrise
annotating a stack of philosophy papers
arguing footnotes with anyone who sits down
drafting a seminar paper in a corner booth
hunting down one elusive citation
writing deep into the quiet hours

personas.name: Mateo Vasquez
personas.persona: I am Mateo Vasquez, 18, a first-year at Penn and Elena's younger brother. I am eager, a little overwhelmed, and grateful my sister already knows where everything is.

schedule.activity: trailing an older sibling around
finding his feet at the union

personas.name: Diego Torres
personas.persona: I am Diego Torres, 24, a graduate student in architecture at Penn. I am creative, focused, and always sketching. I spend long hours in the Meyerson Hall studio.

schedule.activity: working on a studio model
studying precedents in the gallery exhibits
researching precedents for a project
attending a guest lecture
refining the model

personas.name: Sofia Ramirez
personas.persona: I am Sofia Ramirez, 18, a first-year still finding my way around Penn. I am wide-eyed, friendly, and curious about everything on campus.

schedule.activity: wandering the gallery exhibits
sitting in on a guest lecture
settling in for dinner at the union
feeling queasy at the table
feeling much better at last

relationships.description: Diego sits in on Professor Tanaka's public guest lectures at Irvine whenever architecture and physics cross paths; she knows him by name from the question line.
Maya and Priya have been study buddies since freshman bio and meet most mornings in Van Pelt to grind through problem sets together.
Theo and Priya bonded over a logic elective and have argued about proofs, free will, and whose coffee order is worse ever since.
